items.label: Gap to the vehicle in front
items.value: At least 2 seconds on a dry road; at least 4 seconds on a wet road; braking distances can be up to 10 times longer on ice

items.label: Car towing a caravan or trailer
items.value: 50 mph on single carriageways; 60 mph on dual carriageways and motorways; not in the right-hand lane of a motorway with 3 or more lanes

items.label: Drink-drive limit (England and Wales)
items.value: 35 µg per 100 ml of breath · 80 mg per 100 ml of blood · 107 mg per 100 ml of urine

items.label: Minimum tyre tread depth (cars)
items.value: 1.6 mm across the central three-quarters of the tread, all the way round

items.label: First MOT
items.value: When the car is 3 years old

items.label: New drivers
items.value: 6 or more penalty points within 2 years of passing: licence revoked

items.label: Using a hand-held phone while driving

sources.ref: Using mobile phones when driving: the law

items.label: Child car seats
items.value: Until the child is 12 years old or 135 cm tall, whichever comes first

items.label: Passing a cyclist
items.value: Leave at least 1.5 metres at speeds up to 30 mph, more at higher speeds

items.label: Passing a horse rider or horse-drawn vehicle
items.value: At no more than 10 mph, leaving at least 2 metres
